name: Arroz Con Leche
instructions: In a saucepan , cook the rice on low heat with enough water to cover , until the water has evaporated
Warm up the milk , and add it to the saucepan , along with the lemon zest
Cook for about 25 minutes on low , use a wooden spoon to make sure that it doesn't stick to the bottom
Add the sugar , remove from the heat , and keep moving the rice around the pan
Remove the lemon peel , and serve on the desired containers
Sprinkle some of the cinnamon before serving
